name: Create a compliance task
description: Creates a compliance task in the Inbox, with an owner and a due date, for something your own cross-check found that no deterministic finding covers. Fyniq raises the findings' own tasks itself: never propose one for a finding it gave you, and never a second for a finding that has a task open or proposed. The task is a reminder for a person: it files, approves or marks nothing as met.

finding_key.description: Your finding's stable key, agent: and words, such as agent:director-loan-2026: the same finding keeps the same key.

title.description: What the person must do, in plain words.

detail.description: Why, what to do next and the rule and source behind it.

owner_role.description: The role whose members own the task.

due_on.description: The date it is due by, as 2027-01-31.
